title: UCP Metadata
description: Protocol metadata for discovery profiles and responses. Uses slim schema pattern with context-specific required fields.

version_constraint.description: Version range requirement with minimum and optional maximum.

max.description: Maximum compatible version (inclusive). When absent, no upper bound.

requires.description: Version requirements for extension schemas. Declares minimum (and optionally maximum) protocol and capability versions needed for correct operation.

capabilities.description: Required capability versions, keyed by capability name. Keys must be a subset of the extension's $defs keys.

map_order.description: Preferred key order for map-valued fields in the scope annotated by the containing `ucp` member. Each property names a target map, and its array lists target keys in preferred order. Lists may be partial and are not allowlists.

members.description: Members defined inside the reserved `ucp` protocol object. The object is open for forward compatibility: consumers MUST ignore unrecognized members. Only UCP core defines members, and every defined member MUST be safe to ignore.

entity.description: Shared foundation for all UCP entities.

schema.description: URL to JSON Schema defining this entity's structure and payloads.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entity instance. Used to disambiguate when multiple instances exist.

config.description: Entity-specific configuration. Structure defined by each entity's schema.

delegate_scope.title: Business Profile Delegate Scope
delegate_scope.description: Grants a delegate authority over one registry. v1 scope is registry-level only: it names a registry, not individual entries within it. A scoped delegate may contribute any number of entries to the granted registry.

registry.description: Registry the delegate may manage. Well-known values: `services`, `capabilities`, `payment_handlers` (the registries defined in `#/$defs/base`). UCP core does not currently define other delegable registries.

delegate.title: Business Profile Delegate
delegate.description: A resource the Business authorizes to manage part or all of its profile configuration. Delegation grants authority over profile configuration only; it does not delegate Business identity, protocol-version authority, cryptographic trust, or runtime execution.

profile.description: HTTPS URI of the delegated resource. Fetched and parsed the same way as a `supported_versions` profile URI, but the retrieved document is validated as `profile.json#/$defs/delegate_contribution_schema`, not as a full Business or Platform profile.

scope.description: Registries this delegate may manage. Omitted: complete-profile delegation. Complete-profile delegation is exclusive in v1 — it MUST NOT coexist with local `services`, `capabilities`, or `payment_handlers` entries, with another delegate (scoped or complete), or appear more than once.

delegate_contribution.title: Business Profile Delegate Contribution
delegate_contribution.description: Profile configuration contributed by a delegated resource, scoped per the Business's `delegates` declaration. Reuses the canonical `services`, `capabilities`, and `payment_handlers` registries and `map_order` so delegated and Business-owned configuration compose under identical registry semantics. A contribution MUST NOT carry `version`, `supported_versions`, or `delegates`: protocol-version authority and delegation authority remain exclusively with the Business root and cannot be replaced, extended, or delegated onward by a delegate.

map_order.description: Preferred key-traversal order for registry entries this delegate itself contributes. MUST NOT order or suppress Business-owned entries or another delegate's entries.

services.description: Service registry entries contributed by this delegate, keyed by reverse-domain name.

capabilities.description: Capability registry entries contributed by this delegate, keyed by reverse-domain name.

payment_handlers.description: Payment handler registry entries contributed by this delegate, keyed by reverse-domain name.

base.description: Base UCP metadata with shared properties for all schema types.

map_order.description: Preferred key-traversal order for sibling registry fields inside the root `ucp` envelope (`services`, `capabilities`, and `payment_handlers`).

status.description: Application-level status of the UCP operation.

services.description: Service registry keyed by reverse-domain name.

capabilities.description: Capability registry keyed by reverse-domain name.

payment_handlers.description: Payment handler registry keyed by reverse-domain name.

success.description: UCP metadata with status 'success'. Use for response branches that carry the expected payload.

error.description: UCP metadata with status 'error'. Use for response branches that carry error information.

platform_schema.title: UCP Platform Schema
platform_schema.description: Full UCP metadata for platform-level configuration. Hosted at a URI advertised by the platform in request headers.

business_schema.title: UCP Business Schema
business_schema.description: UCP metadata for business/merchant-level configuration. Subset of platform schema with business-specific settings.

supported_versions.description: Previous protocol versions this business supports, mapped to profile URIs. Businesses that support older protocol versions SHOULD advertise each version and link to its profile. Each URI points to a complete, self-contained profile for that version. When omitted, only `version` is supported.

delegates.description: Resources the Business authorizes to manage profile configuration. Resolved only for the selected `ucp.version`'s profile, after protocol-version selection; delegation relationships are not inherited or composed across different protocol-version profiles. See `#/$defs/delegate` and `#/$defs/delegate_contribution`.

allOf.title: Complete-profile delegation is exclusive
allOf.description: If any declared delegate omits `scope` (complete-profile delegation), it MUST be the Business's only delegate, and the Business's own `services`, `capabilities`, and `payment_handlers` registries MUST be empty: complete-profile delegation cannot coexist with local registry entries, another complete delegate, or a scoped delegate.

response_order_schema.title: UCP Order Response Schema
response_order_schema.description: UCP metadata for order responses. No payment handlers needed post-purchase.

response_cart_schema.title: UCP Cart Response Schema
response_cart_schema.description: UCP metadata for cart responses. No payment handlers needed pre-checkout.
